validity.valid_run: Both official training commands and both official planning commands exit 0; both formal checkpoints exist; each evaluation has exactly 50 ordered outcome bits, a matching native success rate, and a 50-item state_0/state_g sidecar; paired-task claims require state sidecars to match item-by-item; PBS Exit_status is 0; indexed GPU telemetry is present at 5-second cadence.
validity.partial_or_invalid: Any timeout, missing checkpoint, fewer than 50 outcomes or target states, mismatched native aggregate/vector, changed task identity, missing telemetry, invalid data preflight, or nonzero PBS Exit_status makes the experiment partial/invalid; preserve outputs and do not resume with a changed scale. Missing official train observation clips or failure of representative official train/validation __getitem__ checks before GPU work also invalidates the run.
validity.claim_boundary: At most, report the two official D=384 mlp_var cells. Call them paired only if native state_0/state_g sidecars match item-by-item. This is not the full paper grid, its three planning seeds, or a robust average gain.

comparison_boundary.dense_control: The official dense arm uses the same RDMReg/SWD formulation with identity link and Gaussian target. It is not a verbatim reproduction of original LeWM SIGReg.
comparison_boundary.project_jepa_pusht: Do not compare absolute success rates directly with this project's frozen LeWM + PushT experiments. Dataset/task selection, model training and planner/evaluation implementation must first be shown identical; this protocol only establishes an official LpWM pipeline result.
comparison_boundary.systems: No latency, memory, sparsity-kernel, deployment, or acceleration claim is tested.
